label: Model estimate, not a guarantee
reason: No scored Test series with a marked home side was available, so no win probability and no expected margin were calculated. Wikidata has 22 rugby union match items with scores for two teams. Of the sport-wide scored rows, 17 are between items typed as national rugby union teams. 1 scored rugby union match item marks a home team. Home advantage is not fitted from a list that short. 13 of the 22 stored scored rows do not have a national team in the name. API-Sports is not used. Current fixtures, lineups and timelines are refreshed by scripts/fetch-rugbyapi.mjs into data/rugbyapi-snapshot.json.

howCalculated.summary: Ranking points move with the exchange World Rugby publish. Home sides are treated as three points stronger. A win probability and an expected margin are fitted only after a long scored series exists. They are not typed in.
steps: Take scored matches that name a home team and an away team.
Start a team at 30 ranking points the first time it appears. That is the published starting point for a new full member, not a predicted score.
After each match, move points with the published exchange. The home rating is three points higher while the exchange is calculated.
A win by more than 15 points multiplies the exchange by 1.5. A Rugby World Cup Finals match doubles it.
On matches before 2024, fit the chance of a home win from the pre-match gap, and fit the margin with a straight line.
Check that fit on later matches: the share of correct winners, and the average absolute margin error.
Use the ratings after the last match for the next fixture. If the series is too short, write no probability.

formulaCheck.example: Wales 76.92 at home against Scotland 76.36, Wales won 23-10. World Rugby's explanation gives an exchange of 0.64.

rankingGap.note: Difference of published ranking points after the published three-point home adjustment. Not a win probability and not an expected margin.

worldRugby.licenceNote: World Rugby publishes these ranking points. They are not CC0. The numbers are stored with attribution and are not a prediction.
